never: guess what a job needs when the record holds no needs list
trust a van count older than the business's limit
write a purchase order outside Material Order's path
order a part that cannot arrive before the job
substitute a part, or change a job's parts list, without a person
order or message twice for one job on a re-run
stays_with_person: moving a job, or sourcing a part, when the lead time misses the slot
writing the needs template for each job type
every flag on the exceptions queue

provider_block.job: the tech opens the van tomorrow and the part is there

with_us.note: No hosted step. The check runs on the business's own board, van counts and shelf, and a shortfall is ordered through Material Order's path, whose order write is the builder's until Office Voice's purchase order tools ship. The pass test runs on the business's own systems.

checks.title: Tomorrow's jobs come from the dispatched board, by job id, and a job added later re-runs for that job only
What a job needs comes from the record, and a job with no needs list is flagged, never guessed
Van stock is read with the time it was counted, and a count older than the limit is flagged, not trusted
Shelf stock is reserved to the job before anything is ordered
A shortfall is ordered only through Material Order, one request per supplier per run, and a second run orders nothing again
A part that cannot arrive before the job is flagged with the reason, not ordered and hoped for
An equivalent part is a suggestion on the flag, never a change to the order, the reservation or the tech's list
Each tech is told once per job, with the job id: what is on the van, what to pick up and where
The run publishes by the cut-off whether or not it found anything, and every flag goes to the exceptions queue with an owner
